author: reek
body: Bill of Materials generation. Produces grouped, sorted, and formatted BOM reports from placed component data. Supports CSV, JSON, HTML, and plain text output formats.

author: reek
body: Joins the reference designator list into a comma-separated string such as "R1, R2, R3".

author: reek
body: Formats an integer price in cents to a display string. For example 1250 becomes "12.50".

author: reek
body: Produces a one-line summary such as "12 unique parts, 47 total, $125.50".
